generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
DECLARATIONS: The bidder shall submit the duly signed declaration furnished in the bid document

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka public procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement Condition
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The successful bidder shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing as on the last date of submission of bid.
The bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates. The successful bidder shall strictly adhere (GoK circular no. Dated 07.11.2023) to Rule 36 & 42 of Karnataka Mineral Concession Rules 1994 & its amendments thereof. If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish documents related to remittance of royalty charges for Coarse aggregate, Fine aggregate, murrum etc., as per Rule 44(4) of Karnataka Mineral Concession (amendment) Rules 2023, prevailing royalty charges along with following penalty will be recovered from the work bills. a) A penalty of 5 times the royalty amount & additional payment (AP) of 40% royalty amount to Department of mines and Geology. b) A penalty of 10% of royalty amount and the same will be transferred to District Mineral Foundation Trust.

The bidder should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved
Bidder should have independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection

The bidder shall register himself under section 7 and their workers who will be engaged for the works under section 12 of the Building and other construction workers (Regulation of employment & conditions of services) Act 1996
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only
The bidder shall quote item rates on the basis of prevailing market rate.

Bidders shall give declaration regarding payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the government from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him. Failing which, the bids are liable for rejection
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL
The successful bidder shall obtain ESI coverage for all the workers deployed for this work if required

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/document furnished by the bidder should the circumstances so warrant in the overall interest of the Corporation. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect or invalid, then tenders of such bidders will be cancelled and the EMD furnished by such bidders will be forfeited
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority

The successful bidder shall furnish Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) in the form of DD/NEFT or e-Bank Guarantee from any schedule bank acceptable to the Corporation, Insurance Surety Bonds issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India and enter into an agreement within 20 days of receipt of letter of intent through e-portal
Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) shall be equivalent to 5% of the Contract amount and should be valid for 30 days after the date of completion of defect liability period

Work completion period is 04 (Four) months excluding monsoon. Defect liability period for the work is 12 (Twelve) months from the date of completion of work. Contract period is 16 (Sixteen) months (i.e Work completion period & Defect liability period).

Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from office of the Executive Engineer (Civil) Jog, Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd., Jog-577435, Sagar Taluk, Shivamogga District, during office hours. Mobile- 919449598829
If tenderer has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practice, action shall be initiated finance department, Government of Karnataka Notification No.FD884 Exp-12/2019, Bengaluru, dated 7th May 2020

The successful bidder shall make payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the Government of Karnataka from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one civil work of value not less than Rs. 19.92 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years (i.e.2021-2022, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The past experience should be supported by original scanned copy of the Work done certificate issued from state/central Government/Government under taking from the officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer. (Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

Tender capacity A x N x 2.5 - B, where A Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years updated to 2026-27 price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited for 0.33 year. B Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.33 year period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited

The intending bidder should have achieved in at least Two (02) financial years an average annual financial turnover Rs. 39.83 Lakhs in the last 05 (Five) financial years (i.e.2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). Turnover certificate, duly certified by chartered Accountant (along with UDIN No) shall be furnished. (Financial turnover of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

itemList.description: Cutting and burning or disposing off Apu / Jondu from marshy areas as directed with all other ancillary operations complete.

Earth work excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft,approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical specifications,Including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work.

Providing and Filling in foundation with granite / trap broken metal 100mm and down size with approved Sand including hand packing, ramming, watering including cost of all materials and labour with all lead and lift complete as per specifications.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:2:4 (M15) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:2:4 (M15) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth,sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.
Cutting of Trees, excluding removal of stumps and roots of trees, Girth from 300 mm to 600 mm

Providing weep holes in Brick masonry/Plain/ Reinforced concrete abutment, wing wall/ return wall with PVC Pipe 110mm outer dia at 2 kg per m2, extending through the full width of the structure with slope of 1V :20H towards drawing foce. Complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications

Available rubble stone/boulder filling between or behind abutment/below apron including cost of labour, hand packing, finishing top surface & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification.
Providing Coursed rubble masonry(first sort) with hard stone in foundation and plinth with cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement: 6 coarse sand)

Providing Flush/ Ruled pointing: Pointing on stone work with cement mortar 1:3 (1 cement : 3 fine sand) after raking joints to depth nicely lining, including cost of materials, labour, curing as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
